name: Lead email - 1st attempt
subject: Granite Depot- Let's find your perfect stone
body:
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

Thank you for reaching out to {{company.name}}! My name is {{user.first_name}}, and I'll be assisting you with your countertop project.


Here is our live inventory link where you can browse our available slabs and explore different colors:

https://{{company.subdomain}}.granite-manager.com/customer/{{company.id}}/stones

Once you have an idea of what you like, just let me know and I'll get started on your quote right away!


If you're also looking at cabinets, we can help coordinate both parts of the project so measurements, design, and scheduling stay organized. Many of our customers find this much easier than working with multiple vendors.


We have a large selection of granite, quartz, quartzite, and marble available on-site, allowing you to see full slabs in person rather than relying on small samples. We are located at {{company.address}} and are open {{company.hours_of_operation}}.


When would be a good time for you to stop by?

name: Lead email - 2nd attempt
subject: Granite Depot - Countertop options for you
body:
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

This is {{user.first_name}} with {{company.name}}.


I'd be happy to put together a short list of options that fit your design style while staying within your preferred budget range. This can make the selection process quicker and help prevent unexpected costs later on.

If you send me a few quick details - your approximate budget, your desired timeline, and the look you're going for (subtle and uniform vs. bold movement and veining) - I'll narrow everything down and recommend the best options for you.


Could you send me those details so I can get started?

name: Lead email - 3rd attempt
subject: Granite Depot - Still planning countertops?
body:
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

This is {{user.first_name}} with {{company.name}}.


I wanted to follow up and see where things currently stand with your countertop project. If you're still considering moving forward, I'd be happy to help make the next steps as easy as possible based on your schedule.

Here's our live inventory link if you'd like to continue looking through our available options:

https://{{company.subdomain}}.granite-manager.com/customer/{{company.id}}/stones

Are you hoping to get started soon, or are you thinking of putting the project off until a little later?

name: Thank You for Your Request
subject: Thank You for Your Request
body:
Hi {{customer.first_name}}, This is {{user.first_name}} with {{company.name}}.

Thanks for reaching out about your kitchen project!

Before we start looking at stone options, what are you hoping to find? Do you already have a specific color or style in mind, or are you still exploring?


You can also browse our stone colors here:

https://{{company.subdomain}}.granite-manager.com/customer/{{company.id}}/stones


Looking forward to connecting!
